audit: A.T.O.M product capability, UX and growth audit
head: d0763974e2b5b68c209fda5c680cdfd8b1bdde2a

capabilities.current_workflow: Open menu → New / Duplicate / Delete / rename / switch
capabilities.limitations: Menu has no Escape close

capabilities.current_workflow: Edit anything; reload restores draft inputs
capabilities.limitations: Results are not restored: draft reload shows 'Run needed'; saved Version reload shows 'Ready · UNAVAILABLE · Run unavailable'

capabilities.current_workflow: Save version (optional change summary) → named Scenario + Version
capabilities.limitations: Auto-name 'Sector plan 1' persists after switching to Network; header 'Version 1 Unsaved' vs Results 'No saved Version'; accessible name 'Save current' ≠ visible 'Save version'

capabilities.current_workflow: Select Version → branch; delete → Undo
capabilities.limitations: Lives in Plan stage, far from Review where alternatives are judged

capabilities.ui_entry_point: Plan → Scenarios → collapsed 'Compare Scenarios and Versions'
capabilities.current_workflow: Expand disclosure → pick A/B Scenario and Version
capabilities.limitations: Separate from KPI comparison in Results; collapsed by default

capabilities.capability: Two-scenario KPI comparison and A/B map switch
capabilities.ui_entry_point: Review → Results → Compare (only without a network result)
capabilities.current_workflow: Save two Versions → Results → Compare → choose A/B → Show A / Show B
capabilities.limitations: Compare tab shows 'Baseline vs Recommended' whenever a network result exists, so scenario comparison is unreachable in the main network workflow

capabilities.purpose: Move or back up a project
capabilities.current_workflow: Export downloads JSON; Import validates bounded file
capabilities.persistence_behavior: File; excludes Run History and coverage surfaces
capabilities.limitations: Filename has no date/Version (repeat exports collide); menu note is dense

capabilities.capability: Cell inventory search, filter and scope
capabilities.current_workflow: Search by Cell/record ID; filter by technology; scope Network / Map area
capabilities.limitations: Empty search state until a query is typed

capabilities.capability: Cell placement and per-cell RF profile editing
capabilities.ui_entry_point: Inventory → Place new Cell / cell editor; draggable marker
capabilities.current_workflow: Place or select cell → edit position, carrier, power, antenna, receiver fields
capabilities.limitations: Long single-cell editor (1080 px scroll); no bulk edit; no undo for edits

capabilities.purpose: Bring a bounded external cell list
capabilities.current_workflow: Import file → validation → cells added
capabilities.limitations: Not exercised in browser in this audit; relies on unit coverage

capabilities.capability: Plan setup (mode, technology, model, TX power)
capabilities.current_workflow: Choose Single/Network, 4G/5G/6G research, propagation model, TX power
capabilities.limitations: Invalid value shows no inline error/aria-invalid; map prompt misdirects to Inventory

capabilities.capability: Network cell selection (click or drawn area)
capabilities.ui_entry_point: Map toolbar → Select cells / Draw selection area
capabilities.current_workflow: Select cells → click markers or draw polygon → Finish
capabilities.limitations: Area selection silently keeps 'nearest 8' of 272 and says 'towers'; Map key overlay swallows vertex clicks

capabilities.current_workflow: Pre-selected cell → Run Sector
capabilities.persistence_behavior: Run history record; layers not retained
capabilities.limitations: Map does not fit to result; default result is 99.2% blocked (4G: 84.2%) without interpretation

capabilities.current_workflow: Open Propagation → Auto-Optimize Sector
capabilities.limitations: Action lives in a different stage from the command-bar run

capabilities.current_workflow: Select ≥2 cells → Evaluate Network
capabilities.limitations: Results not fitted on map

capabilities.capability: Network azimuth optimization with goals, constraints and Pareto search
capabilities.ui_entry_point: Simulate → Propagation → Optimize Network; goals under Advanced analysis
capabilities.current_workflow: Propagation → (Advanced: priorities/constraints) → Optimize Network → live progress
capabilities.persistence_behavior: Run history; recommended azimuths written into draft
capabilities.limitations: Goals hidden in 'Advanced analysis'; action not in command bar; strong progress feedback

capabilities.ui_entry_point: Review → Results → Solutions → Inspect / Apply solution…
capabilities.current_workflow: Explore solutions → Inspect → Apply solution… → new Version or branch
capabilities.limitations: Apply is disabled when the optimization ran on an unsaved draft (the default path); no recovery instruction; 25 near-identical cards, no trade-off chart

capabilities.current_workflow: Inspect solution → Explain on a cell
capabilities.limitations: Only reachable deep inside Solutions

capabilities.current_workflow: Network mode ≥2 cells → bandwidth/load/reuse → Analyze
capabilities.limitations: Tool shows no summary or next step after analysis; command-bar CURRENT chip disappears

capabilities.purpose: Find one additional cell from dataset candidates
capabilities.current_workflow: Network mode, 2–5 cells, drawn area → Candidates → Recommend candidate cells → Apply as scenario
capabilities.result_output: Up to 5 ranked options with reasons
capabilities.limitations: Tab is replaced by 'Solutions' after a Pareto optimization; area drawing auto-selects up to 8 while recommendation requires 2–5

capabilities.capability: Received-signal surface, contours and GIS export
capabilities.current_workflow: Run → Signal toggle (or Generate raster + contours) → GeoTIFF / Contours / CSV
capabilities.limitations: Single-cell only by design (stated)

capabilities.current_workflow: Comma-separated values per dimension → Queue matrix → table + Pareto SVG
capabilities.limitations: Free-text comma lists; operates on the active single cell without saying so in Network mode

capabilities.ui_entry_point: Propagation → Advanced analysis; RF Diagnostics → Open vertical path profile
capabilities.current_workflow: Pick receiver point → analyze
capabilities.limitations: Nested under a disclosure labeled 'Advanced analysis'

capabilities.current_workflow: Run building-entry estimate
capabilities.limitations: Clear boundary copy; not exercised end-to-end here

capabilities.capability: Research references (sub-THz atmospheric, P.1411, material, specular reflection)
capabilities.ui_entry_point: Propagation and RF Diagnostics → Research / reference
capabilities.current_workflow: Expand Research disclosure → pick endpoint → run reference
capabilities.limitations: Correctly isolated; adds disclosure depth

capabilities.current_workflow: Load campaign file → split strategy → Run RF diagnostics
capabilities.limitations: Shares 'measurement validation' wording with the CSV workflow in Data

capabilities.capability: Measurement validation (CSV) and global bias calibration
capabilities.ui_entry_point: Review → Data → Research / reference → Measurement Validation
capabilities.purpose: Compare predictions with measured RSRP; optionally apply a correction
capabilities.current_workflow: Import CSV (≤5,000) → Evaluate residuals → explicit apply
capabilities.limitations: A documented first-class feature that changes canonical RF is filed under a 'Research' disclosure in Data

capabilities.current_workflow: Open Data → Demand surface counts → Dataset details → Activate pack
capabilities.limitations: Only one pack installed; 'Pack QA status good' lowercase

capabilities.current_workflow: Filter by scope/type/status → open run → rerun or Generate report
capabilities.limitations: Runs labeled by hash only; no headline metric or difference

capabilities.ui_entry_point: Review → Report; Run history → Generate report
capabilities.purpose: Share evidence with someone not using A.T.O.M
capabilities.current_workflow: Report → PDF / Print or Markdown (also stores a Report) → download/regenerate
capabilities.result_output: Markdown/HTML with tables and SVG map
capabilities.limitations: UUID filenames; duplicated 'RF Result' sections; ~600 lines inline SVG; contradictory lineage ('Version 1 · Runs: None')

capabilities.ui_entry_point: Click map objects (rays, gaps, samples, residuals, buildings)
capabilities.current_workflow: Click object → Inspector drawer
capabilities.limitations: Result layers are canvas; keyboard users cannot reach them

capabilities.current_workflow: Layers → Appearance (Light/Dark/System), Basemap, Viewport buildings
capabilities.limitations: Appearance is inside 'Layers'

capabilities.current_workflow: Always visible, collapsible
capabilities.limitations: Clips SINR section at 1440×900; truncates 'Working dr…'; intercepts drawing clicks

capabilities.ui_entry_point: Command bar chip, Results context card, legend
capabilities.purpose: Prevent stale results being read as current
capabilities.current_workflow: Automatic
capabilities.limitations: Mode switch marks results 'out of date'; hash-heavy copy; reload yields 'Ready · UNAVAILABLE'

capabilities.current_workflow: Enable overlay → connect sidecar
capabilities.limitations: Requires separate sidecar; not exercised

capabilities.capability: Headless/API workflows (OpenAPI, batch process, CLI runner)
capabilities.current_workflow: HTTP API / go run ./cmd/run-experiment
capabilities.limitations: Developer audience

capabilities.current_workflow: Python CLI preview/build
capabilities.limitations: Not in-app by design

capabilities.current_workflow: Toggle overlay at zoom ≥12
capabilities.limitations: Export only via API
